fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2025-10-17 (afternoon, 13:10): The complainant found that a signature resembling theirs had been used on a document connected to Rs. 50,000, though no such signing had taken place. The complainant, Logesh Palanisamy, provided the contact number 9000000171. The complainant alleged that Harish Murugan may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000180. Items referenced in the complaint: physical documents and digital documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Forged signature reportedly used to obtain payment.
fields.Keywords: forgery, forged signature, documents, suspect, afternoon, digital document, main street, mobile number
